meta.title: People of the State of California v. Sephora USA, Inc., Final Judgment and Permanent Injunction (San Francisco Superior Court, 24 August 2022)

section.title: Injunctive provisions

paragraph.lga:citation: People v. Sephora, Final Judgment, para. 11

section.paragraph: To the extent DEFENDANT SELLS the PERSONAL INFORMATION of CONSUMERS, including through SALES USING ONLINE TRACKING TECHNOLOGY, DEFENDANT shall provide notice to CONSUMERS as required by Civil Code section 1798.135, subdivision (a) that clearly states that it SELLS their PERSONAL INFORMATION, and that CONSUMERS have the right to opt-out of all SALES.

paragraph.lga:citation: People v. Sephora, Final Judgment, para. 12

section.paragraph: DEFENDANT shall process CONSUMER requests to opt out signaled via the Global Privacy Control or the "GPC."

section.title: Monetary provisions

paragraph.lga:citation: People v. Sephora, Final Judgment, para. 17

section.paragraph: DEFENDANT shall pay the Attorney General the amount of $1.2 million.
